note_10fold: 0.6266 is within 0.0004 of the published 0.627. Fold count is a free knob; a 10-fold estimate is not a fair comparison to their 10-fold-inner/20x10 protocol without matching everything, so this is suggestive not decisive.
headline_finding: Almost all of the FC->cognition correlation is age and sex. After partialling both out of the target, the connectome explains r=0.14. Neither SOTA paper reports this decomposition, and it reframes what 'predicting cognition from the connectome' means at this effect size.
